Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS

analysis.summary: VA Tech Wabag reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY 2027, with consolidated revenue growing 20.8% year-over-year to INR 887 crores and EBITDA increasing 21.7% to INR 116 crores. The company maintained its net cash positive position for the 14th consecutive quarter, standing at INR 965 crores excluding HAM. The order book reached a historic high of INR 19,400 crores, providing strong execution visibility. Management highlighted major international order wins, including a landmark SWRO desalination plant in Kuwait and an STP win in the UAE, while continuing to focus on asset-light, technology-led growth. VA Tech Wabag reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY2027, with revenue growing to INR 8,868 million and EBITDA reaching INR 1,163 million at a 21.7% margin.

guidance.claim: Management has guided for a 15% to 20% revenue growth rate.
guidance.quote: See we have already guided for a 15% to 20% growth, Shubham, and we are confident of meeting that.

guidance.claim: The company maintains a medium-term blended EBITDA margin outlook of staying within 13% to 15%.
guidance.quote: And that is why in our medium-term outlook, we gave a blended EBITDA margin outlook of staying within 13% to 15% of EBITDA.

guidance.claim: Management expects to realize a 13% to 14% EBITDA margin band for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: But realistically, with the kind of projects we have, it is more fair to expect a 13% to 14% kind of band in this year.

guidance.claim: The company targets a Return on Capital Employed (RoCE) of greater than 20%.
The medium-term outlook includes keeping the order book at least 3x of revenues.
guidance.quote: We said we will keep our order book at least 3x of revenues.

guidance.claim: The medium-term 3 to 5-year outlook for O&M is to take it to 20%.
guidance.quote: O&M at 17% we said that our medium-term 3 to 5-year outlook is to take it to 20% and we are working and on track from that perspective.

demand_outlook.claim: Water security needs driven by urbanization, climate change, industrialization, and tightening environmental standards continue to support demand for desalination and reuse.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we see a healthy opportunity pipeline across our target markets, growing water security needs driven by urbanization, climate change, industrialization and tightening environmental standards continue to support demand for desalination and reuse, particularly in water stressed regions.

demand_outlook.claim: Despite recent geopolitical developments, management has seen no material impact on projects, operations, or underlying demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the recent geopolitical developments, we have seen no material impact on our projects, operations or underlying demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Saudi Arabia has announced 2027 as the Year of Water, highlighting the strong focus on water infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: And also to reinsure their focus on water, 2027 has been announced as a Year of Water by Saudi.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the order pipeline indicates significant growth opportunities moving forward.
demand_outlook.quote: Our order pipeline indicates significant growth opportunities even going forward.

demand_outlook.claim: All clusters delivered on order intake, resulting in an order book surge.
demand_outlook.quote: All clusters delivered on order intake which resulted in our order book surging to approximately INR 19,400 crores, even as we persisted with our selective approach to bidding for projects.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that water capital allocation is at an all-time high globally and in India.
demand_outlook.quote: See the capital which is allocated for water is all-time high.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees an addressable core market opportunity of $75 billion to $100 billion in the next five to seven years.
demand_outlook.quote: And if you put all this together, this is almost 75 billion to 100 billion in next five to seven years is the opportunity.

demand_outlook.claim: In the GCC, management sees an average of $5 billion per year of opportunity for the next 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: For the next 10 years, we see an average of $5 billion per year of opportunity.

margins_costs.claim: EPC contributed 82% of revenues and O&M contributed 18% during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EPC contributed 82% of the revenues while O&M contributed 18%.

margins_costs.claim: Geographically, 48% of the revenues came from India and 52% from overseas markets.
margins_costs.quote: Geographically, 48% of the revenues came from India and 52% from overseas markets, emphasizing our growing global presence and geographical diversification, in line with our long-term strategy.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that margins continued to remain in line with the medium-term target.
margins_costs.quote: Our strong performance is reflected in excellent execution discipline, with margins continuing to remain in line with our medium term target.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company ensures bottom-line growth exceeds top-line growth.
margins_costs.quote: If we grow on top line 20%, we ensure that the bottom line grows more than 20%. That's what is profitable growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Order intake during Q1 was over INR 3,400 crores, of which INR 29.6 billion was EPC and INR 4.7 billion was O&M.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order intake during Q1 was over INR 34 billion, over INR 3,400 crores, of which about INR 29.6 billion was EPC and INR 4.7 billion was O&M.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book position reached a historic high of INR 19,400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book position reached a historic high of INR 194 billion, that is INR 19,400 crores, almost $1.8 billion, which is over four times of our revenue base, providing very strong visibility for execution over the coming quarters and years.

orders_capacity.claim: International markets accounted for 77% of the order intake in Q1 and 23% came from India.
orders_capacity.quote: International markets accounted for 77% of the order intake in this quarter and 23% came from India.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book surged to approximately INR 19,400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: All clusters delivered on order intake which resulted in our order book surging to approximately INR 19,400 crores, even as we persisted with our selective approach to bidding for projects.

orders_capacity.claim: The company closed the year with an order backlog of INR 17,200 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Today we have INR17,200 crore of order backlog.

orders_capacity.claim: Order intake for the year was close to INR 7,500 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order intake we closed with INR 7,500 crore almost that is year-over-year.

orders_capacity.claim: O&M accounts for almost 40% of the company's order backlog.
orders_capacity.quote: O&M is almost 40% of our order backlog.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remained net cash positive for the 14th consecutive quarter with a net cash balance, excluding HAM, of INR 965 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continued our net cash positive position for the 14th consecutive quarter with a net cash balance, excluding HAM standing at INR 965 crores as of this quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital days for the period stood at 108 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital days for the period stood at 108 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company extended its positive net cash position streak to the 14th consecutive quarter, reaching INR 965 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In this quarter, we continued to grow profitably, extending our positive net cash position streak to the 14th consecutive quarter to reach INR 965 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a final dividend of INR 5 per share, up from INR 4 per share last year.
capital_allocation.quote: And in line with the performance, the board recommended a final dividend of INR 5/- per share, up from INR 4/- last year, recommended to the shareholders for approval.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the year net cash positive for the sixth consecutive year and thirteenth consecutive quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We closed the year as net cash positive for sixth consecutive year and thirteenth consecutive quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Government spending shifts, such as spending more money on oil, could lead to cutbacks in other areas.
risks_headwinds.quote: Government spending, it depends like now, if we are spending more money on the oil, naturally government will have to cut down some spending somewhere.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the objective remains to take the industrial order mix to around 20% to 25%.
management_commitments.quote: So, we would say over a period of time, our objective will remain to take industrial order mix to be around 20% to 25%.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to increasing water positivity by 50% by 2030.
WABAG targets increasing gender diversity among employees through a 12% female employee mix by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Increase gender diversity among employees through 12% female employee mix by 2030

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the order book will be kept at least 3x of revenues.
management_commitments.quote: We said we will keep our order book at least 3x of revenues.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a medium-term outlook to take the O&M share to 20%.
management_commitments.quote: O&M at 17% we said that our medium-term 3 to 5-year outlook is to take it to 20% and we are working and on track from that perspective.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
